raw_text: Node.js Nacos native addon: Rust `nacos-sdk-rust` via `napi-rs`; config, naming, gRPC subscriptions (`ThreadsafeFunction`), Promises, `Option<T>`→`T | undefined | null`, errors→JS `Error`. Rust: `src/*.rs` (`lib.rs`, `config.rs`, `naming.rs`, `plugin.rs`); generated `index.d.ts`. Yarn 3.4.1; Cargo. Build: `yarn build:debug`; target: `yarn build --target <target-triple>`. Test: `yarn test __test__/index.spec.mjs` (build first; `index.node` required). AVA, 3-minute timeout. `removeListener/unSubscribe` are NOOPs. Clients are stateful; create once and reuse. Auth: HTTP token or Alibaba Cloud RAM. Build requires `nacos-sdk-rust` and `napi`. On build failure: `rustup update stable && cargo update`.
